{
  "test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection3",
  "test_code": "using System;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection3\n{\n    private const string NestedResolverSource = \"\"\"\n        using MessagePack;\n\n        namespace TestNamespace\n        {\n            public partial class OuterContainer\n            {\n                public partial class InnerContainer\n                {\n                    [GeneratedMessagePackResolver]\n                    public partial class NestedCompositeResolver\n                    {\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public class SamplePayload\n            {\n                [Key(0)]\n                public int Value { get; set; }\n            }\n        }\n        \"\"\";\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task NestedCompositeResolver_EmitsExcludeFromCodeCoverage_WithBalancedDirectives()\n    {\n        var (output, runResult, generatorDiagnostics) = await RunGeneratorAsync(NestedResolverSource, Array.Empty<string>());\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        foreach (GeneratorRunResult result in runResult.Results)\n        {\n            Assert.Null(result.Exception);\n        }\n\n        Assert.Empty(output.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        GeneratedSourceResult generatedSource = runResult.Results\n            .SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources)\n            .Single(s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"NestedCompositeResolver\")\n                      && s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"IFormatterResolver\"));\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatedSource.SyntaxTree.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        SyntaxNode root = await generatedSource.SyntaxTree.GetRootAsync();\n        int ifCount = root.DescendantTrivia(descendIntoTrivia: true).OfType<IfDirectiveTriviaSyntax>().Count();\n        int endIfCount = root.DescendantTrivia(descendIntoTrivia: true).OfType<EndIfDirectiveTriviaSyntax>().Count();\n        Assert.True(ifCount >= 2, \"Expected #if directives for ExcludeFromCodeCoverage on resolver and FormatterCache.\");\n        Assert.Equal(ifCount, endIfCount);\n\n        ClassDeclarationSyntax resolverDecl = root.DescendantNodes()\n            .OfType<ClassDeclarationSyntax>()\n            .Single(c => c.Identifier.Text == \"NestedCompositeResolver\");\n        Assert.Contains(\n            resolverDecl.AttributeLists.SelectMany(a => a.Attributes),\n            a => a.Name.ToString().Contains(\"ExcludeFromCodeCoverage\"));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverSymbol = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TestNamespace.OuterContainer+InnerContainer+NestedCompositeResolver\");\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverSymbol);\n        Assert.Contains(\n            resolverSymbol!.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? cacheSymbol = resolverSymbol.GetTypeMembers(\"FormatterCache\").SingleOrDefault();\n        Assert.NotNull(cacheSymbol);\n        Assert.Contains(\n            cacheSymbol!.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n    }\n\n    [Theory]\n    [InlineData(\"NETSTANDARD2_0\")]\n    [InlineData(\"NETFRAMEWORK\")]\n    public async Task NestedCompositeResolver_CompilesWithoutAttribute_WhenExcludedByPreprocessorSymbol(string symbol)\n    {\n        var (output, runResult, generatorDiagnostics) = await RunGeneratorAsync(NestedResolverSource, new[] { symbol });\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        foreach (GeneratorRunResult result in runResult.Results)\n        {\n            Assert.Null(result.Exception);\n        }\n\n        Assert.Empty(output.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverSymbol = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TestNamespace.OuterContainer+InnerContainer+NestedCompositeResolver\");\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverSymbol);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\n            resolverSymbol!.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? cacheSymbol = resolverSymbol.GetTypeMembers(\"FormatterCache\").SingleOrDefault();\n        Assert.NotNull(cacheSymbol);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\n            cacheSymbol!.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n    }\n\n    private static async Task<(Compilation Output, GeneratorDriverRunResult RunResult, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> GeneratorDiagnostics)> RunGeneratorAsync(\n        string source,\n        string[] preprocessorSymbols)\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> references = (await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None))\n            .AddRange(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest, preprocessorSymbols: preprocessorSymbols);\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, parseOptions) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        return (output, driver.GetRunResult(), generatorDiagnostics);\n    }\n}"
}
